evidence_classes.inventory: Dictionary membership or uniqueness only; independent_witnesses is forbidden.
evidence_classes.within-family-replication: At least two dictionaries in exactly one witness family; not independent confirmation.
evidence_classes.cross-family-confirmation: At least two distinct witness families; independent_witnesses must equal the family count.

rules: Never infer independent witnesses from headword agreement or dictionary count.
Every new cross-dictionary claim must label within-family replication versus cross-family confirmation.
PD's single-dictionary-unique inventory is inventory-only, not independent textual attestation.
DCS and Dharmamitra chronology agreement is one collaborative lineage, not two confirmations.
Apte remains an independent European control; indigenous koshas remain separate anchors.
